# AI grandma and grandpa characters with real wrinkles and attitude

**An exact age, one behaviour that doesn't fit it and a loud outfit become an 80+ character sheet ready for video.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_12e07c5ef65c.webp" alt="A tiny grandma in a leopard coat and curlers appears on her character sheet, then rides a red Vespa down a sunny Sicilian alley waving a wooden spoon." width="480"></p>

Makes very old AI characters people remember, on varg: grandmas and grandpas (80+) with a contrast between age and behaviour, real wrinkles and age spots, a loud signature outfit and one prop, as a character sheet ready for scenes and video. Use when someone asks for an AI granny or grandpa, an old lady or old man character, a babushka, nonna or abuela, an elderly influencer, or an old character for an ad. Part of varg-character-design (definition, sheet, reuse in video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-character-grandma                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-character-grandma --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 80+ character sheet ready for video |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.07 per sheet (Seedream 5 Pro, tested) |
| Uses | varg API, Seedream 5 Pro, Nano Banana 2.1, Kling 4, Seedance 2.5 |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

- "Create a 91-year-old abuela character in a neon windbreaker for a snack ad"
